title: Generation of multivirus-specific CTLs
protocol: Dilute heparinized peripheral blood in an equal volume of D-PBS or RPMI 1640 at ambient temperature.
Overlay approximately 10 ml Lymphoprep with 20 ml of diluted blood in a 50 ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 400 x G for 40 minutes at ambient temperature.
Harvest PBMC interface into an equal volume of D-PBS or RPMI 1640.
Centrifuge the harvested PBMCs at 450 x G for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove supernatant from the centrifuged PBMCs.
Loosen pellet by finger-flicking and resuspend in 20 ml of D-PBS or RPMI 1640.
Centrifuge the resuspended cells at 400 x G for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 20 ml complete medium.
Count PBMCs; if red blood cell contamination is present, add 20 ml of 50% red cell lysis buffer and count again.
Plate PBMCs at 2 x 10^6 cells per well of a 24-well plate.
Incubate the plated PBMCs overnight at 37°C in 5% CO₂ in X-vivo 15 media.
Harvest non-adherent PBMCs after incubation.
Dislodge adhered monocytes using a cell scraper or sterile transfer pipette and transfer to an appropriately sized centrifuge tube.
Pellet PBMC by centrifuging at 400 x G for 5 minutes in a 15ml centrifuge tube.
Remove supernatant and loosen pellet by "finger-flicking".
Add clinical grade Adenovirus pp65 to produce the appropriate multiplicity of infection.
Incubate for 120 minutes at 37°C/5% CO₂.
Wash cells 4 times by centrifugation at 400 x G for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant and loosen pellet by "finger flicking".
Add complete culture medium to resuspend cells at a final concentration of 1x10⁶ per 1ml.
Aliquot 2 ml per well of 24-well plate.
Culture for 9-12 days at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Harvest cells from 24-well plates.
Wash CTLs by centrifuging at 400 x G for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet by "finger flicking".
Resuspend CTLs at a concentration of 1 x 10⁶ cells/ml of complete medium.
Centrifuge over LSM gradients to remove dead cells if necessary.
Aliquot 1 ml of cells into wells of a 24 well plate.
Restimulate with autologous irradiated Ad5f35CMV pp65 transduced LCL at a MOI of 100 iu/cell and a responder to stimulator ratio of 4:1 (2.5x10^5 stimulator cells per well).
Culture for 4 days.
Feed with a half change of medium.
Wait an additional 4 days before adding IL-2 if cells look healthy.
At the end of the second stimulation, aliquot CTLs at 5 x 10^6 cells as a backup if sufficient cells have been obtained.
Centrifuge cells to be frozen at 400 x G for 5 minutes.
Aspirate cell culture supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellets by gentle "finger-flicking".
Place cells on ice for 10 minutes to cool.
Resuspend cells in freezing medium not greater than 10^7 cells/ml.
Distribute aliquots of cells/freezing medium mixture into labeled cryotubes.
Place tubes in Nalgene freezing containers and transfer to -80°C freezer overnight.
Transfer to the designated liquid nitrogen freezer for storage.
Cells are stimulated twice a week with 40-100 units/ml of IL-2 according to expansion rate.
Harvest cells weekly.
Pool harvested cells.
Count pooled cells.
Replate cells at a density of 1 × 10^6 responder cells per well in a 24 well plate or 1 × 10^6 responder cells per mL in a bag.
Restimulate cells with irradiated transduced autologous LCL at a ratio of 4:1 (responder to stimulator).
Split rapidly growing CTL lines on the day of IL-2 feed if necessary.
Replate cells at 2 × 10^6 cells per well if there are more than 3 × 10^6 cells per well.
Characterize and freeze cells when sufficient for patient infusion according to dose and Body Surface Area.
Set up cytotoxicity assays with 5 × 10^6 cells within one week of freezing CTLs.
Perform phenotyping with an additional 2 × 10^6 cells.
